case.title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o., Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH. RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series. Need: 4200 pc a year. message.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Dear Mr Dralveck,

You wrote that your CNC machines are ready for this job, and Option A is built to keep them busy on the HX pump shaft at a price we can approve.

Here is why we are asking for a different number than yours.

On quality:
Your quality was 1863 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70210@2026Q3).

On the competing offer:
Another supplier has offered EUR 31.50 for this part (offer:70240-0).

On the steel cost side:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

Our proposal: unit price EUR 26.53; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.

Option A is the package we can approve. Given the quality record, the other offer and the movement in bar prices, it is the one that puts this work on your shop floor on terms we can stand behind.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.body:
Dear Ms Fuchsreiter,

You sent us your price for the HX pump shaft and offered to clarify anything. What matters to us is a price that lets us place this part with you as a long-term partner, so I will be direct.

Option A is the package we can approve. It sets a clear unit price and a defined lead time for a part that will be needed in the new HX series, and it gives your shop a firm basis to plan on.

On the competing offers:
Another supplier has offered EUR 31.50 for this part (offer:70240-0).
Another supplier has offered EUR 36.00 for this part (offer:70210-0).

On your side:
Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH looks for new customers (news:20260309-03).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 27.89; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 28.04; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.

Option B is a genuine alternative if a longer payment term suits you better, but Option A is the one we can take forward.

Ms Fuchsreiter, what would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.body:
Dear Ms Procházková,

You wrote that you want to be a reliable, long-term partner, and Option A is built for that: it gives you a clear, settled arrangement for the HX shaft, with the most generous payment term of our three options.

On quality:

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

On energy costs:
German electricity producer prices changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 25.99; payment 90 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 25.84; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option C: unit price EUR 25.76; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.

Option A is the package we can approve. Given the cost trends above, it is the one that reflects your steady quality while giving you the longest payment term.

For your management, in plain words: Option A gives Strojírna Hrvelec a dependable partner for the HX series, a settled price and the longest payment term of the three options. Please take Option A to your management for approval as it stands.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Hallo,

Hallo, you did your homework on the steel prices and the other offer, I respect that. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. Our current defect rate for you is about 1200 ppm. We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached. 

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. The 14 days payment works well for us, so I am happy to take your terms. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. I can drop the price to €30.50, which beats your other guy and gets the machines running for you. 

Our current proposal is a price of €30.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

On energy costs:
German electricity producer prices changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

Option A: unit price EUR 25.99; payment 90 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 25.84; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.

For your management, in plain words: Option A gives Strojírna Hrvelec a dependable partner for the HX series, a settled price and the longest payment term of the three options. Please take Option A to your management for approval as it stands.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
